notes.title: Hello everyone!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are currently working alot to bring the trailer to your hands but firstly we need to work on the demo! We dont got a date for the demo yet but will have only the poolrooms, 1 entity (that you can disable if you want), 2 main puzzles atleast and 1 optional puzzle, we cant wait to bring you guys into the world of "The Transitions". Meanwhile we have posted and will keep posting some sneak peaks and videos of the environment of the game.

Dont forget to wishlist the game,that will help us alot!
